'''Elizabeth Spencer Allman''' (born 1965)<ref>Birth year from [http://id.loc.gov/authorities/names/no96019330.html Library of Congress catalog entry], retrieved 2018-12-01.</ref> is an American [[mathematician]]. She is a professor of mathematics in the Department of Mathematics and Statistics at the [[University of Alaska Fairbanks]]; her research interests range from [[abstract algebra]] and [[algebraic statistics]] to [[Mathematical and theoretical biology|biomathematics]] and [[phylogeny]].<ref>{{citation|url=http://cnsm.uaf.edu/directory/name/elizabeth-allman/|title=Elizabeth S. Allman|work=Directory|publisher=University of Alaska Fairbanks College of Natural Science and Mathematics|accessdate=2018-12-18}}</ref>

==Education==
Allman earned her Ph.D. in 1995 from the [[University of California, Los Angeles]] under the supervision of Murray M. Schacher. Her dissertation, in [[abstract algebra]], was ''Polynomials Without Roots in Division Algebras''.<ref>{{mathgenealogy|name=Elizabeth Spencer Allman|id=36667}}.</ref>

==Contributions==
With her Fairbanks colleague John A. Rhodes, Allman is the author of a book on [[mathematical biology]] and [[mathematical model]]ing, ''Mathematical Models in Biology: An Introduction'' (Cambridge University Press, 2004).<ref>Reviews of ''Mathematical Models in Biology'':
*{{citation|title=none|journal=Mathematical Medicine and Biology|year=2005|doi=10.1093/imammb/dqi008|first=N. F.|last=Britton|volume=22|issue=3|pages=289–290}}
*{{citation|title=none|journal=Mathematics and Computer Education|volume=39|issue=1|year=2005|last=Rauff|first=James V.|pages=78–79}}
*{{citation|title=none|first=Nick|last=Lord|journal=[[The Mathematical Gazette]]|volume=89|issue=514|year=2005|pages=173–175|jstor=3620700|doi=10.1017/S002555720017740X}}
*{{citation|title=none|first=Mei|last=Zhu|journal=[[SIAM Review]]|volume=46|issue=3|year=2004|pages=593–595|jstor=20453561}}.</ref>

==Recognition==
In 2012, Allman became a Fellow of the [[American Mathematical Society]].<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.ams.org/profession/fellows-list |title=List of Fellows of the American Mathematical Society |access-date=2014-12-17 |archive-date=2018-08-25 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180825194636/http://www.ams.org/profession/fellows-list |url-status=dead }}</ref>
